summary: Iteration 197: Tested Nora AI Function Calling for nutrition and exercise management. Backend tests: 13/13 PASSED. All action handlers (UPDATE_CALORIES, ADJUST_MACROS, ADD_EXERCISE, CHECK_WEIGHT_GOAL) work correctly. Business rules enforced: calories/macros blocked when weight goal active, exercises always allowed. Frontend chat-ia.tsx has proper action card rendering code with green/red styling for success/failure.

integration_issues.issue: During Playwright testing, chat requests returned 401 Unauthorized with session_id=chat-undefined-beneficiary. This indicates the user context (user.id) is undefined when building the session ID. The issue appears to be a timing/state issue during automated testing - the AuthContext may not be fully loaded when the chat component renders.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add null check for user.id in chat-ia.tsx chatSessionId calculation to prevent 'undefined' in session ID
critical_code_review_comments: chat-ia.tsx line 105: chatSessionId uses user?.id which can be undefined, causing session_id=chat-undefined-beneficiary. Consider adding a guard: const chatSessionId = user?.id ? (isGuardian && selectedBen ? `chat-${user.id}-${role}-${selectedBen}` : `chat-${user.id}-${role}`) : null;
